manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 222
text:
Page 001
001-1. MYSKILLS ARE LACKING,I EVENFAILED ASNEAKATTACKON HER STOMACH.
001-2. DAMNIT!
001-3. OH YEAH, DOES THESAYING"ROWING A BOAT UPSTREAM,IFYOU STOP MOVING FORWARD YOU FALL BACK"APPLY TO MARTIAL ARTS?
001-4. IT DOES.
001-5. WHY? YOU WANT MY MARTIAL ARTS TO RE- GRESS?
001-6. NO NO,I'M JUST ASKING. HOWLONG WILL IT TAKE?
001-7. HMM~FORME TO REGRESSTO YOUR LEVEL,ITLL PROBABLY TAKE A FEW DECADES~
001-8. AH!? WON'T YOU BE ANOLD LADY BY THEN?
001-9. HMPH~ THAT'S ONLY IF I DON'T PRACTICE MARTIAL ARTS AT ALL,
001-10. DON'TFORGET THAT I'MSTILL PRACTICING WITH MY SWORD EVERY DAY.
001-11. NO!IHAVETO WORKHARD!INEED TO PUSHDOWN THE WARRIORESS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE!
001-12. HMM?
001-13. WHAT'S THE WARRIORESS LOOKING AT?
001-14. AH,IT'S THE RING TOSS GAME.

Page 002
002-1. SHE PROBABLY FEELSLIKESHE'LLBE BULLYING THEM IF SHE PLAYS, JUSTLIKE WHAT HAPPENEDATTHE AMUSEMENTPARK LASTTIME.
002-2. WANT TO PLAY?
002-3. LOOKAT THAT VASE, IT'S QUITE NICE.
002-4. WE CANBRING IT BACKFOR THE GINGERPLANTOR PUTINSOME FLOWERS...
002-5. IT'S ONLY EIGHT YUAN IF YOU BUY IT!
002-6. 每200元20 ￥7.8起热销款￥9.9 特价粗陶罐子多肉盆花卉绿植盆多肉老庄盆 透气紫砂陶罐法师植物盆 代3万+
002-7. Fun Fact: This hand signal means 大 6in Chinese.
002-8. IFYOUSCORE ALI 10 RINGS,YOU WILL EARN A PROFIT OF 60 YUAN!
002-9. YOU'RE GOING TO CARRY ALL 10 VASES?
002-10. ICAN'T DO THAT.
002-11. IT'LLBE HARD FOR ME TO CARRY THAT MANY TOO.AND WHYDO YOU WANT TO BRING SO MANY BACK?
002-12. WE'LL USE THEM SOMEWHERE.
002-13. I'VE HEARDMANY DISCUSSIONSABOUT WHICHONETHEYWANT, BUTIVENEVERHEARD OFTHISKINDOFDIS- CUSSION BEFORE.
002-14. NO MATTER WHAT, ICANTLETTHS BUSINESSOPPORT- UNITYESCAPE.
002-15. AHEM,HOW ABOUT'IGIFT YOU A RING TO OU RINL T PLAY WITH?
002-16. THAT.. WOULDN'TBE GOOD, RIGHT? THE OTHER CUST- OMERS ALLRAD~
002-17. IT'S OKAY~
002-18. I DON'T BELIEVE SOMEONEWON'T PLAY AGAINAFTER MISSING THEFIRST ONE.
002-19. HMM...
002-20. HMM~~

Page 003
003-1. 灵光一现！！ HOW ABOUT THIS!
003-2. WE'LLBUY A RING FOR TWO YUAN!HOW ABOUT THAT?
003-3. HAA?
003-4. AFTER SAYING ALL OFTHAT,ITTURNSOUT HEWASRELUCTANTTO SPENDMONEY?!
003-5. THIS YOUNG MAN LOOKSLIKEAPRETTY NORMALGUYHANGINGOUT WITHHISWELL-MATCHEDGIRL- FRIEND,BUT HETURNSOUTTO BE STINGYAND JUSTWANTS TO SPEND TWO YUAN TO HAVE A GOODTIME?
003-6. TSK.NO WONDERTHEY'RE EMPTY-HANDED
003-7. THAT'S ALSO FINE...HERE.
003-8. DING!
003-9. IT'S NOT A LOSS FOR MEANYWAY,
003-10. WECHAT RECEIVED TWO YUAN.
003-11. EVEN IFTHEYDON'T CONTINUE TOKEEP PLAYING AFTER MISSING AND LEAVE, I'LL STILL BE ABLE TO MAKE TWO YUAN..
003-12. HUH?
003-13. THANK YOU, UNCLE!
003-14. USING THESKILLS OFSLAYINGDRAGONS TAATAAAI
003-15. T/N: Basically talking about ha.T.iha b

Page 004
004-1. JOCAICHLOACHESTS PRETTYGOODTOO~
004-2. nowSiangHedsinghersknis is overkill for ring toss.
004-3. BUT....
004-4. WHYARE THERE SO MANY FLOWERS?
004-5. AH~~NO WONDER,
004-6. T/N:Qixi is Chinese Val- entine's Day on Aug 10.
004-7. TODAY ISQIXI.
004-8. SO IT'S VALENTINE'S DAY,I WAS WONDERING WHY THE NIGHT MARKET IS SO BUSY TODAY.
004-9. T/N:The character for holiday/ festival is part of Valentines day, so this is why she's saying this.
004-10. HOLIDAY?
004-11. ARE WE EATING AREWEEATING DUMPLINGS?
004-12. NO NO NO~,IT'SA DAY FOR LOVERS.
004-13. I'MNOT EATING DUMP- LINGS,BUT I CAN EAT FEET...
004-14. Fun Fact: Chinese 不吃饺子， people online use 可以吃jiojio…… "jiojio" as slang for feet.
004-15. I'M NOT HUNGRY YET...HAHA...
004-16. WAIT A MINUTE,YOU SAID PINGPING WANTED TO TAKE YOUTO SEE A MOVIE TODAY? ISN'T THAT TRYING TO SOW DISCORD BETWEEN US? ASKING YOU NOT TO ACCOMPANYMEONQIXI AND ACCOMPANY HERINSTEAD?
004-17. IT'S NOT LIKE YOU WERE GOING TO TAKE ME.
004-18. IT'SREALLY DIFFERENTFROM USUAL, THERE'SMANY COUPLES HOLDING FLOWERS INTHER HANDS.
004-19. THEN WE'LL GO SEE A MOVIE NOW!
004-20. IT'LLBE VERY LATE WHENWE'RE DONE.
004-21. HMMM-

Page 005
005-1. Then I'll buy you a gift.
005-2. A gift..
005-3. WHY DID WE GO TO SUCH A BRIGHTAND SHINYSHOP?
005-4. FORTUNATELY WEWENTFOR A WALK AFTERDINNER,AND THE SHOPS AREN'T CLOSED YET.
005-5. JUSTINTIMETO PICKOUTAQIXI GIFTFORTHE WARRIORESS! IT'LL BE MEANNGLESS WHENQIXI ISOVER~
005-6. RED...
005-7. IS RED GOOD?

Page 006
006-1. YOU LIKE RED, ALRIGHT! WELL BUY THAT ONE!
006-2. HOW MUCH IS THAT?
006-3. IT'S SO PRETTY!
006-4. SIR, THIS SUZHOU EM- BROIDERY SILK SCARF COST...
006-5. FOUR HUNDRED AND EIGHTY- EIGHT YUAN.
